title: LearnOps course model (B2, v1)
description: DRAFT, not approved and not frozen. Confirmed decisions and open items are recorded in docs/decisions/0003-b2-course-model.md. The OPEN DECISION markers in this schema identify only some unresolved fields and are not the complete list, so a field without a marker is not settled. A normalised JSON description of a course, read by the checker and built from a Moodle backup (.mbz) or a course package (PRD B2). It describes what a course IS, including a broken course, so that the checker can report the problem. This schema checks structure only and must never reject a course-design error.
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose: after Release 0 contracts change only by adding optional fields and readers ignore unknown fields (PRD B.0, A9, EXT-02). A null means the source does not carry the value, for example a package has no Moodle visibility setting, or that the item does not exist, as stated on each field. For visible and completion_enabled, null never means false, and the checker treats it as cannot judge, not as a fault. Deliberately NOT enforced here, because a course that breaks them must still validate so that a rule can report it: unique or well-formed idnumbers (CK-06), protected items (CK-07), points summing to the target (CK-03), references inside availability, criteria or badges pointing at real activities (CK-04, CK-08), circular unlock rules (CK-05), completion rules that can be met (CK-02), a valid marking table with matching points (CK-09), marking workflow being on (CK-10), H5P having no grade item (CK-11), relative media paths (CK-12), and completion tracking on activities used in unlock rules (CK-13). The inner form of availability belongs to Moodle and is not described here. Unique cmid values are not enforced either; the model builder guarantees them. CK-07 compares protected items field by field against a supplied reference model of the template course, using the same comparison as FR-C-05; there are no fingerprints. The model holds no body text or attached files, so a change to those cannot be seen.

schema.description: Contract name and version. Changing this value is a breaking change requiring v2.

badges.description: null when the source does not carry them: a package never does (PRD B1.4). An empty array means the source carries badges and has none.

idnumber.description: As found in the source, with no format check, because invalid and duplicate values are what CK-06 reports. null when there is none. Protected idnumbers are allowed, because CK-07 needs to see them (unlike B1, which rejects them).

visible.description: null means the source does not say, as in a package. It never means false: the checker treats it as cannot judge, not as a fault.

availability.description: Moodle's own availability JSON, kept whole so that no information is lost (PRD B2). null means no restriction. A package unlock rule is written in this same form, with its date as a Unix timestamp for 00:00 in the configured site timezone (see source.timezone). In completion conditions, cm = -1 means OPTION_PREVIOUS: the nearest earlier activity in course order with manual or automatic completion tracking. Activities without tracking are skipped. If no eligible activity exists, the condition cannot be met. An unresolved -1 is reported as CK-04. This rule is documented but still requires Moodle lab verification.

cmid.description: Moodle course-module ID used to reference an activity. Never compare CMIDs between models; idnumber is the stable identity. Package-derived models use synthetic positive CMIDs numbered from 1 in document order. Never use 0 or -1. Synthetic CMIDs are local to their own model.

source.description: Where the model came from. Kind is mbz or package. OPEN DECISION: the values and requirement for mode are not yet confirmed.

mode.description: The package's output mode (PRD B1.4). CK-07 needs it because a sections-only package leaves out protected items on purpose.

timezone.description: The configured site timezone used to convert package dates to 00:00, for example Asia/Kolkata for the lab. Required for all sources: non-empty for package sources and null for mbz sources.

completion_enabled.description: Course-level completion tracking. null means the source does not say, as in a package. It never means false: the checker treats it as cannot judge, not as a fault.

total_points.description: Optional course points target. When absent or null, the checker uses the B1 default of 100.

number.description: Moodle's section number. Moodle has a section 0, so the minimum is 0, not 1 as in B1.

idnumber.description: Nullable section identity. Moodle course_sections has no idnumber field, so mbz-derived models use null. Sections are matched by section number.

activities.description: In course order. May be empty.

completion.description: The activity's completion rule. A rule that can never be met must still validate (CK-02).

tracking.description: Completion tracking mode: none (Moodle value 0), manual (Moodle value 1), or automatic (Moodle value 2).

use_grade.description: Complete when a grade is received.

pass_grade.description: Complete only with a passing grade.

grade_item.description: null means no grade item. This also answers whether an H5P activity is graded (PRD B2, CK-11).

max_grade.description: Maximum grade. A number, not an integer, because Moodle grades can be decimal.

marking_table.description: Marking table summary with present and points_total. It does not contain a valid field; marking-table validity is checked by CK-09.

points_total.description: Sum of the table's Points column. null when there is no table or it cannot be parsed.

type.description: page, assignment, url, label or h5p (the B1 names). Any other type keeps Moodle's module name and is reported as not checked (PRD C2.8), so this is not an enum.

marking_workflow.description: null when the source does not carry it, as in a package.

media_refs.description: Optional. Every media reference found in the activity, as written, so that CK-12 can report full URLs. Empty means none found. If absent, CK-12 cannot judge the activity's media references.

criterion.description: One course-completion or badge criterion. CK-08 reports a criterion that refers to a missing item, so the reference is not checked here.

type.description: The kind of criterion, for example activity. Open, because Moodle has several.

cmid.description: The activity referred to, as found in the source. It may not exist in this model.

idnumber.description: The referred activity's idnumber, when the builder can resolve it.

course_completion.description: null when the source does not carry it: a package never does (PRD B1.4).
